villageLost.beat: No one is left to pick up the Codex. The village dies out — quietly, the way villages do. The season ends here.

deathDayLines.line: No one is left to pick up the Codex. The village dies out — quietly, the way villages do. The season ends here.
— DAY 27 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Zafer Gul reads the sky: clear tomorrow, cold.
You wake with a start — something is wrong.
📦 A care package drops from the sky with a little parachute. There's a note: "WE LOVE YOU!"
Inside: Spare battery
Plus 37 kcal of fan-approved snacks.
★ IDENTIFIED: Dog Rose Hip. Rose hip. Bright red-orange oval fruits on the thorny rose canes. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Naming things. Very human. The audience approves.
Megan was watching. Now they know Dog Rose Hip too.
Two eyes, forward-facing, unblinking. No wingsound. Owls don't make sound when they hunt — that's the problem.
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. The absence of sound, shaped like wings. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ NIGHT COURT! You're on your own.
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.
Megan freezes. "What IS that?"
The moon-shadow is growing under you. Silent dive. MOVE.
(The game is telling you something: this is bigger than one person. Talk to your companions — "We should name this. Us.")
You don't stroll through the Night Court.
💥 Adjournment!
Megan shouts: "Move! MOVE!"
Owl's Adjournment hits you for 18.
It lands on its kill — wings mantling, head turned too far. It stands there, breathing. Grounded.
📖 Codex: Adjournment — strikes one target after a windup. You won't forget this.
You don't stroll through the Night Court.
Two dives and nothing. It pants — owls shouldn't pant. NOW.

📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Leonard Dixon is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
🕯️ Leonard is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

With Haven grieving, Emberhold installs their own speaker at the table — but the bond is young, and they're still deciding what Haven is. The new speaker wants to talk before the tribute changes. Grief delays the verdict: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.
🕯️ Leonard Dixon is dead — combat. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
"Leonard's gone." Guadalupe looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Leonard." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Finn blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 1). A loop of wire on a game trail. Simple, effective, ancient. Check at dawn.
📖 LEARNED: Shoulder Check (Level 1). You know exactly where to hit something with your shoulder so it goes where YOU want. Shove a controlled monster 2 tiles — into its friends, away from yours.

📖 LEARNED: Hogtie (Level 1). Rope, a dazed monster, and thirty seconds of not being eaten. Hogtie a controlled monster: rooted 3 rounds (diminishing), and it can't wind up telegraphs. It can still lash out — the rope holds position, not malice.
🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
📖 The Codex turns a page: Leonard Dixon, 27 days. The mantle passes to Finn Menon.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Finn Menon, 24 — a Rancher.
The village's quarrel was with Leonard — and Leonard is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
At the grave, Guadalupe speaks for Finn — "Leonard trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
The fire knew Finn before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.

🛟 Megan stands up by the fire. "We can't just watch this happen. Here's what we CAN do — pick one, maybe two, but everything costs something."
"Tend the hurt, stretch the food, or hunt it back — pick one, maybe two, but everything costs something."
"Or we rally," Megan adds. "Second shift, everybody. We work, we eat, we live — and we pay for it."
(Relief is open — triage, rations, hunt, or rally, from the beats row. Each option works once; the moment passes in ~3 days.)

👁 It sees you before you see it, and it tells everyone. Take the shot before the cawing starts — after that, the whole woods knows where you're standing.

You see smoke on the horizon. The Red Table — 4 people, 65 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 15 plants — 13 new to you. They look lean — hungry, even. Food would talk here. They've been here the whole time.
Nothing left to take here today.
